name: morphing-tabs
blurb: Tabs that morph together with a gooey fluid effect.
description: Controlled tab component that expands the active tab with margin while an SVG filter creates a blob-like morphing effect between adjacent tabs. Uses CSS filters (feGaussianBlur + feColorMatrix) for the goo effect.
use_when: Tab sets where the visual distinction and playful morphing animation enhances the UI, especially in modern dashboards or creative interfaces.
avoid_when: When accessibility is critical; lacks keyboard navigation. Not suitable for dense tab lists where animation overhead is a concern.
a11y: No built-in keyboard support or ARIA attributes. Relies on parent to handle focus management and tab semantics.
